system.flavor: A 5.2mm electrothermal competition pistol built for IPSC shooters - the ammo capacity of a Minor class gun with the muzzle velocity and hitting power of the Major calibers, with a custom barrel compensator and a Zeiss-Nikon COT scope.
system.notes:
Solo of Fortune 2 p.65 text layer: PIST +3 L P 2H6+3 5.2mm ET 24 3 VR 75m, 'Tsunami Express racegun 15,300 Euro!'. Two independent OCR channels plus a fresh tesseract pass all read the price as 15,300 and the damage glyph as '2H6+3'.

Damage resolved to 2D6+3 by Blackhand's Street Weapons p.14 (PDF idx 15), which prints 2D6+3 (5.2MM ET) 24 3 VR - Blackhand's lists the price as 5300eb and the range as 5M (a dropped digit; SoF2 prints 75m). SoF2's printed 15,300 is stored. 5.2mm ammo 50eb per box of 50; a 50-shot battery is 10eb. Cannot be suppressed (barrel compensator); a grip change drops WA to +2 for 125eb and makes it concealable.
